backend.model: Qwen-Image fp8: qwen_image_fp8_e4m3fn.safetensors, text encoder qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors, qwen_image_vae.safetensors
backend.licence: Apache-2.0 (Qwen/Qwen-Image model card on Hugging Face; fp8 repack Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI, same licence)
backend.sampler: ComfyUI KSampler euler/simple, 20 steps, cfg 2.5, ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 3.1, 1024x1024
backend.cutout: BiRefNet ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet (MIT), tmobile-sandbox uc28/icons.py cut --fill-all --bg auto (edge colour un-mixed from the light grey background)

styles.marker: closest to the brief: clean outline, flat colour, reads well at 64 px
styles.paper: the model adds a stack of torn coloured paper behind most subjects; it becomes part of the cutout and the silhouette is not the object
styles.clay: nicely 3D, but fingerprint texture on every surface and one wrong subject (party_popper)

love_heart.notes: fine; clay has a visible fingerprint in the middle

hand_thumbs_up.notes: WRONG GESTURE in all 6: index finger pointing up, thumb tucked in; prompt needs rework (e.g. describe the thumb pointing up and the four fingers curled into the palm)

hand_peace.notes: gesture right, fingers countable at 256 px

feel_angry.notes: marker 7540: tongue out, reads as cheeky rather than angry

cutout_check: checked on checkerboard and dark background: no light or dark halo; no EDGE or EMPTY warnings

I1.review: by eye on the 30 sheets; pick null = no usable seed

styles.marker: clean; some seeds have a floating cast-shadow stroke under the object (prompt: drop the ground shadow)
styles.paper: the coloured paper stack behind the subject is still there on most seeds; objects get cut-out human silhouettes (ring, crown, coffee, laptop)
styles.clay: no fingerprints any more; objects turn into mascot characters (ring, crown, confetti, popper, heart, coffee, laptop, eyes) -> object-only wording needed
